<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="375" height="667" viewBox="0 0 375 667">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="667" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- dimmed profile screen behind verification sheet -->
  <rect x="0" y="24" width="375" height="54" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <ellipse cx="30" cy="59" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#939393"/>
  <text x="55" y="57" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Profile</text>
  <circle cx="340" cy="51" r="17" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
  <circle cx="340" cy="51" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="56" x2="350" y2="61" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="18" y="94" width="339" height="183" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity=".08"/>

  <polygon points="130,273 204,203 245,236 286,190 357,273" fill="#7D8490" opacity=".75"/>

  <text x="34" y="331" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#939393">Add a verification photo to build trust</text>

  <rect x="18" y="353" width="339" height="56" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="381" r="17" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
  <text x="47" y="386" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">A</text>
  <text x="76" y="377" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Photo verification</text>
  <text x="76" y="395" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#939393">Not verified yet</text>
  <polyline points="330,374 336,381 330,388" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="0" y="602" width="375" height="65" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="602" x2="375" y2="602" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="42,623 52,615 62,623 62,638 42,638" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polyline points="126,638 126,624 137,615 148,624 148,638" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="218" cy="625" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="225" y1="632" x2="232" y2="639" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="305" cy="622" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
  <ellipse cx="305" cy="637" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="52" y="655" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">HOME</text>
  <text x="137" y="655" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">DISCOVER</text>
  <text x="218" y="655" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">LIKES</text>
  <text x="305" y="655" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" fill="#939393">PROFILE</text>

  <!-- dimming layer -->
  <rect x="0" y="24" width="375" height="643" fill="#000000" opacity=".48"/>

  <!-- bright verification panel -->
  <rect x="11" y="75" width="353" height="517" rx="23" fill="#000000" opacity=".16"/>
  <rect x="11" y="71" width="353" height="517" rx="23" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <text x="187.5" y="111" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Verify your profile</text>
  <text x="187.5" y="134" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#939393">Copy the pose so we know it’s really you</text>

  <!-- pose photo -->
  <rect x="42" y="153" width="291" height="245" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity=".1"/>
  <rect x="42" y="149" width="291" height="245" rx="16" fill="#D0CECD"/>

  <polygon points="54,394 123,293 170,342 223,263 333,394" fill="#939393"/>
  <polygon points="116,394 201,320 239,348 282,305 333,362 333,394" fill="#7D8490"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="358" x2="333" y2="358" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" opacity=".35"/>

  <!-- simplified instructional person -->
  <circle cx="190" cy="207" r="25" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  <ellipse cx="190" cy="275" rx="34" ry="57" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  <line x1="164" y1="257" x2="126" y2="221" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <path d="M254 221 C265 211 270 198 268 184" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="177" y1="324" x2="158" y2="365" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="203" y1="324" x2="222" y2="365" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="112" cy="181" r="8" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
  <circle cx="268" cy="181" r="8" fill="#EA5D6B"/>

  <rect x="63" y="414" width="249" height="35" rx="17" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <text x="187.5" y="436" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">Match this pose in your selfie</text>

  <circle cx="72" cy="476" r="10" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
  <text x="72" y="480" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">1</text>
  <text x="91" y="480" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#4A4A4A">Allow camera access</text>
  <circle cx="72" cy="505" r="10" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
  <text x="72" y="509" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">2</text>
  <text x="91" y="509" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#4A4A4A">Follow the pose on screen</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="53" y="530" width="269" height="44" rx="62" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="187.5" y="558" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">I AM READY</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="53" y="576" width="269" height="44" rx="62" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="187.5" y="604" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">BACK</text>
  </g>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="18" y="16" font-family="SF Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">9:41</text>
  <line x1="321" y1="13" x2="321" y2="8" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="325" y1="13" x2="325" y2="6" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="329" y1="13" x2="329" y2="4" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="341" cy="10" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="10" x2="345" y2="6" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="353" y="5" width="19" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="355" y="7" width="13" height="6" rx="1" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
  <rect x="372" y="8" width="2" height="4" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
</svg>
